msg: Hola, buen día. Somos un grupo de 7 amigas de Bogotá. Tres ya tenemos el Open Water, dos quieren probar el minicurso y dos prefieren snorkel. ¿Cuánto saldría por persona saliendo desde Cartagena y hay descuento por grupo?
reply:
¡Hola! Para salir desde Cartagena, los precios online por persona son:

- Buceo certificado, 2 inmersiones: **630.000 COP**
- Minicurso: **655.000 COP**
- Snorkel, 2 salidas: **448.000 COP**

El descuento de grupo es del **10 % adicional** al descuento online para grupos de 5 o más; aplica a buceo recreativo, minicurso y snorkel. Como son 7, deben pedirlo al equipo **antes de pagar** para que lo aplique; si pagan sin solicitarlo, se pierde. No puedo calcular un total grupal, pero esos son los precios por persona antes del descuento de grupo.

¡Sí, entendí! Para ustedes tres corresponde la salida de buceo certificado de **2 inmersiones**, a **630.000 COP por persona** con el precio online. Las otras dos pueden hacer el minicurso (**655.000 COP por persona**) y las dos restantes snorkel (**448.000 COP por persona**).

Como son 7, el descuento de grupo del 10 % adicional al online aplica a estas actividades, pero deben pedirlo antes de pagar. Les paso con un asesor por este mismo chat para que lo aplique y cierre la reserva en COP.

msg: Hello. My wife and I arrive on a cruise ship in Cartagena on March 3rd, docking at 7:00 am and we must be back on board by 5:00 pm. We would both like to snorkel. Is that doable? We are from Canada.
reply:
Hi! Our snorkeling tour from Cartagena meets at 8:00 a.m. at Muelle de la Bodeguita and returns to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m., so it wouldn’t leave enough time to get back on board by 5:00 p.m. The tour schedule is fixed.

We can’t arrange a different pickup or return time through the standard tour. If you’d like, I can connect you with an advisor to check whether a private service could work; the team will continue the conversation here in this chat.

msg: I see, thanks. Is there anything shorter we could do that gets us back by 3 pm? Or could we go from the islands somehow?
reply:
The standard snorkeling tour from Cartagena returns around 4:15 p.m., and we can’t adjust its schedule. We don’t have a shorter standard snorkeling option from Cartagena. From the islands, the snorkeling activity ends around 12:00–1:00 p.m., but getting there and back from Cartagena is not included in those plans, so it wouldn’t be a practical way to fit your cruise schedule.

A private service may be worth checking, but it has no fixed price and depends on the date and group. I can connect you with an advisor to review the logistics; the team will continue the conversation here in this chat.

msg: No, we're on the cruise ship, we don't have a hotel. Never mind then, thanks for your help.
reply: You’re welcome! Enjoy your time in Cartagena and have a great cruise.

msg: Buenos días. Reservé hace unos días una salida de snorkel para este viernes, pero he visto que dan lluvia. ¿Qué pasa si hace mal tiempo? ¿Me devuelven el dinero o puedo cambiar la fecha?
reply:
¡Buenos días! Si la Capitanía de Puerto cierra las salidas por mal tiempo, primero intentamos reprogramar la actividad. Si no es posible, hacemos el reembolso del 100 %. Las cancelaciones por clima son poco probables porque las Islas del Rosario están en aguas protegidas.

Los cambios de fecha están sujetos a disponibilidad y a nuestros términos y condiciones: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/

Como ya tienes una reserva y preguntas por el clima de este viernes, te paso con alguien del equipo para que te dé información actualizada y revise tu caso. El equipo sigue la conversación por este mismo chat.

msg: Hi, we're two Dutch divers, both Rescue Divers, in Cartagena from the 10th to the 16th. We bring our own full gear. We want to dive on three separate days from Cartagena, coming back to the city each night. What's the best price for us?
reply:
For three separate day trips from Cartagena, the best fit is **Certified Diver – 2 dives (1 day)** on each day. It’s **US$178 per person per day online** (US$197 regular), so I can share the booking link for each day.

With your complete gear, you may qualify for an additional **5% discount** on recreational diving. It’s applied by an advisor before payment, so I’ll connect you with the team here to arrange it. The online discount and own-gear discount can be combined.

Since you’re both international visitors, the booking is paid in USD through the website. You’ll meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. and return to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m. Please allow at least 18 hours after your last dive before flying.

What dates would you like to dive?

msg: Yes please, the 2-dive day trip on the 11th, 13th and 15th. How do we apply the own-equipment discount in the booking?
reply: The 5% full-equipment discount needs to be arranged with an advisor **before you pay**. I’ll connect you with a team member here in this chat to apply it and help coordinate the three dates. Don’t pay through the website until they’ve confirmed how to proceed.

Which departure point would you use?

Bring a swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving equipment is included. The meeting point is **Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.**: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Muelle+de+la+Bodeguita/@10.4199447,-75.5537609,828m/data=!3m2!1e3!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x8ef62f753729822d:0x1bbcdd8224d0eaaf!8m2!3d10.4199447!4d-75.551186!16s%2Fg%2F113gzkckf?entry=ttu

Book here and select your date and number of people: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=es

msg: Hi, my flight lands in Cartagena on Saturday at 11:30 am and I leave on Sunday at 8 pm. I'm PADI Advanced, last dive 3 months ago. Could I fit in some diving? I'm from the UK.
reply:
Since you’re certified, you need to wait **18 hours after your last dive before flying**. A daytime dive on Saturday would mean you can fly from **7:00 a.m. Sunday**, so your Sunday 8:00 p.m. flight is within the safe interval.

The issue is timing: our Cartagena boat leaves at **8:00 a.m.**, before you land on Saturday, and we can’t book same-day. You could book for Sunday, but the boat returns to Cartagena around **4:15 p.m.**, which is very tight before your 8:00 p.m. flight. I’d recommend checking this with an advisor before booking; our team can continue helping you here in this chat.

msg: Wait, I fly on Sunday at 8 pm. So can I dive on Sunday morning and still fly that night?
reply: No. For a certified diver, you need to wait at least **18 hours after your last dive**. A Sunday morning dive would not leave enough time before your Sunday 8:00 p.m. flight. The latest you could dive is **Saturday**, but our boat leaves Cartagena at 8:00 a.m., before you land at 11:30 a.m. on Saturday.

msg: Hello, I have my Advanced and 40 logged dives, and I'd like to do the Rescue Diver course. Do I need EFR? How many days and how much? I'm from France and I'm already staying on Isla Grande at Cocoliso.

For guests already on the islands, the Rescue Diver + EFR course isn’t offered. We offer it departing from Cartagena: **US$796 online per person** (US$884 regular), with lunch included on day 1 only. Since you’re staying at Cocoliso, I’ll connect you with an advisor to check the right option and coordinate the details. The team will continue the conversation here in this chat.

msg: Great. So is that price for someone already at Cocoliso, without the boat from Cartagena? I arrive at the hotel on June 2.
reply:
Sorry for the confusion: the **US$796 online price is for the course departing from Cartagena** and includes the Cartagena–islands boat transfer. The Rescue course isn’t offered as a departure from the islands, so I can’t quote a Cocoliso price without that transfer.

I’ll connect you with an advisor to check the logistics for your June 2 arrival. The team will continue the conversation here in this chat.

Entiendo la preocupación, pero para reservar desde las islas necesitamos que ya tengas el hotel y nos indiques cuál, porque la recogida se coordina allí. No podemos dejar la reserva hecha ni recibir el pago antes de confirmar ese dato.

msg: Hi there! We're a family from Canada staying in Cartagena next month. My wife and I are both Advanced Open Water divers, and we have two kids, aged 11 and 7. What could each of us do on a day trip from Cartagena, and how much would it cost?
reply:
Hi! Diving Planet is Colombia’s first PADI 5-Star dive center, with over 30 years of experience in the Rosario Islands.

For a day trip from Cartagena:

- **You and your wife:** Since you’re both certified, you can each do **Fun Dives – 2 dives (1 day)**: **US$178 per person online** (US$197 regular). You’ll need to show your certification cards.
- **Your 11-year-old:** They can join the **Dive Mini Course** from age 10: **US$183 online** (US$204 regular). It includes pool practice and one ocean dive with an instructor; it doesn’t certify them.
- **Your 7-year-old:** They can join the **Snorkeling Tour**, available from age 6: **US$126 online** (US$140 regular). Snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites; if the group is small, everyone may travel on the same boat.

The online prices include the 10% discount and are per person. The day trip leaves from Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. and returns to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m. The tour includes the boat, equipment, park entry, activity insurance, and lunch.

You can book the dives, mini course, and snorkeling here:
- Dives: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=es
- Mini course: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=es
- Snorkeling: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=es

Since your family has 4 people, the group discount for 5+ doesn’t apply.

msg: Thanks. Our 11-year-old has never dived, he isn't certified. And our daughter is the 7-year-old: so is there really nothing she can do? We can't leave her behind, so would she just stay on the boat while the rest of us are in the water?
reply:
Your 11-year-old doesn’t need certification for the mini course—it’s designed for beginners aged 10 and up. It includes pool practice and one ocean dive with an instructor, and does not certify him.

Your 7-year-old can join the snorkeling tour, which is available from age 6. She wouldn’t need to stay on the boat while you’re in the water. Snorkeling happens in a different area from the dive sites; if the group is small, everyone travels together on the same boat, otherwise the group may split by activity.

msg: That's better, thank you. So my wife and I would do the 2 dives, our son the mini course and our daughter the snorkeling. If both of us are diving, who stays with our daughter while she's snorkeling, given she has to be accompanied? And do we all go on the same boat?

Groups doing both activities may travel on the same boat if the group is small; otherwise they’re split by activity. I can’t confirm who would accompany her specifically, so I’ll connect you with an advisor to coordinate that. The team will continue the conversation here in this chat.

- Dives: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=es
- Mini course: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=es
- Snorkeling: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=es

The online prices are per person: US$178 for each diver, US$183 for the mini course, and US$126 for snorkeling. The team will confirm your booking after reconciling the payment.

msg: Good afternoon. I am from Germany and I hold an Open Water certification, although I have not dived for three years. I am staying in Getsemaní and I would like to dive next Wednesday. My flight home leaves on Thursday at 22:00. Is this possible, and what would you recommend?
reply:
Good afternoon! Since you’ve been out of the water for three years, you’ll normally need a refresher. It’s the mini-course format—pool practice and one instructor-led dive—and takes its own day, so you can’t do the regular dive trip on the same day.

For a daytime refresher, you can fly from midnight that night; for a regular daytime dive, from 7:00 a.m. the following day. So your Thursday 10:00 p.m. flight works after either activity on Wednesday.

You’d depart from Cartagena at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita; staying in Getsemaní doesn’t include hotel pickup. The refresher is booked as **Dive Mini Course** and costs **US$183 online**. You can book here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=es

Wednesday is November 18. Book online before 4:30 p.m. on Tuesday, November 17.

msg: Thank you. What exactly does the refresher consist of? I would prefer to do proper dives on Wednesday: could I do a short review with the guide in the morning and then the 2 dives on the same day? I could also come on Tuesday if necessary.
reply:
The refresher is a full-day activity: theory and practice in the pool, followed by one ocean dive with an instructor. It takes its own day, so it can’t be combined with the two-dive trip that day.

Since you’re available Tuesday too, you could do the refresher on Tuesday and the two guided dives on Wednesday. The refresher is booked as **Dive Mini Course**; the two-dive trip is **Fun Dives – 2 dives (1 day)**. Both depart from Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. and return to Cartagena around 4:15 p.m.

For the two-dive trip, the online price is **US$178 per person**. As you’re visiting from Germany, you pay in USD and book online. The team confirms the booking after reconciling the payment. Book the refresher here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=es and the Wednesday dives here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=es

Please complete the course medical form for the refresher: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. You’ll also need to present your certification card for the Wednesday dives.

msg: Just me. I am sorry, I do not understand the part about 4:00 a.m. Let me ask it plainly: if I do the refresher on Tuesday and the 2 dives on Wednesday, is my flight on Thursday at 22:00 fine or not?
reply: Yes—your Thursday 10:00 p.m. flight is fine. After the two daytime dives on Wednesday, you can fly from 7:00 a.m. on Thursday. The refresher on Tuesday doesn’t change that.

msg: Good, thank you. Two last questions: do you pick me up in Getsemaní or how do I reach the dock, and do I have to bring my certification card or fill in any forms for these two days?
reply:
There’s no hotel pickup in Cartagena. Please make your own way to **Muelle de la Bodeguita** for the 8:00 a.m. departure; ground transport to the dock isn’t included.

For Wednesday’s certified dives, bring your certification card or send us a photo beforehand. For Tuesday’s refresher, complete the course medical form: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. You’ll also need to complete the insurance form sent in your booking confirmation, and the team will send you the liability waiver to fill out.

msg: Gracias. Nos interesa el minicurso, para los dos. ¿A qué profundidad se baja? Y mi esposa pregunta si hace falta saber nadar muy bien, porque ella nada lo justo. Quisiéramos ir el sábado 14 de noviembre.
